summary: Regulation says "at all times." Batch says "by morning." We replay Credit Suisse, the UK gilt crisis, and SVB through two parallel pipelines: batch and streaming, with AI-powered anomaly detection on the streaming side. The audience watches two numbers tick side by side: the compliance gap in hours, and the business value destroyed inside. Real-time compliance, AI, and business value are the same architecture. The batch gap costs millions.
